title: Opening a project no longer waits on the engine: one hydration request, not two per item
description: Fabio 2026-09-17: with 'Auto-start ComfyUI on launch' on, clicking a project did nothing until the engine finished booting. Cause: reconcileAndHydrate makes TWO serial HTTP round-trips per history item (/load-meta then /file-exists) - 300 for a 150-item project - and they queue behind the landing's preview-video loads (which hold connections until navigation) and the 1/s /comfy/status poll, under Chromium's 6-connection cap. Fix: one batch hydration request, plus cancel the grid's in-flight loads at click time.
